relationships.subject: PRP-derived exosomes
relationships.evidence_quote: PRP-derived exosomes promoted the autophagic degradation of NLRP3 by increasing NLRP3 ubiquitination and reducing IL-1β and Caspase-1 production

relationships.subject: PRP-derived exosomes
relationships.evidence_quote: PRP-derived exosomes inhibited the polarization of M1 macrophages by regulating the NF-κB and MAPK pathways

relationships.subject: PRP-derived exosomes
relationships.evidence_quote: PRP-derived exosomes reduced the expression of inflammatory mediators and apoptotic factors, which could thereby alleviate the progression of IDD

key_findings: PRP-derived exosomes promote ubiquitination and autophagic degradation of NLRP3 in macrophages, reducing IL-1beta and Caspase-1 and alleviating IDD.
